name: Swiper
summary: Near-black spend-management SaaS page led by a full product dashboard mock, with a disciplined Inter system, tiny status pills and one electric blue for action.

fonts.pairing: single Inter system: 600 headings with -2% tracking, 13-16px secondary-grey body, 12px uppercase eyebrow pills

signature: hero dashboard mock tilted back 16deg that straightens on view, sitting in a soft ember glow with faint star specks
every section opens with the same small outlined pill eyebrow, giving a product-UI rhythm
semantic accent tokens (green, purple, blue, yellow, red) at 8% fill and 14% border used only for tiny status badges
imagery: almost none; product UI (sidebar dashboard, line chart, category bars) carries the page, case-study cards use aerial and industrial photos
layout_grid: 1200 canvas, 1120 max content with 40px padding (1040 inner), 120px top / 80px bottom section padding, 2x2 and 3x3 grids, 8-12px radius
